install.title: Quick Start
install.html:
Recommended Paths
  • If you do not want to install or configure the project manually: generate videos with an AI Agent
  • If you already have Python and want a direct installation: install the official package with pip
  • Windows users: use the one-click package first for the fastest local trial
  • For source deployment or development: use uv to manage the environment and dependencies
  • If you want a more isolated runtime: use Docker deployment
Generate Videos with an AI Agent

If your AI Agent can read Skill documents and operate a local terminal, send it the prompt below. The Agent will install and configure MoneyPrinterTurbo, generate the video, and return the video file path. It will ask only for required API keys that are not already configured. This workflow currently supports macOS and Windows.

Use this Skill: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/main/docs/skill/SKILL.md
Create a video with the topic "How AI is changing everyday life."
Run in Google Colab

Want to try MoneyPrinterTurbo without setting up a local environment? Run it directly in Google Colab!

Windows

Download the latest Windows one-click package from GitHub Releases, then extract it directly.

  • Download the latest Windows one-click package

Download the .7z archive from the Assets section of that page. The auto-generated Source code (zip) / Source code (tar.gz) archives contain source code only: after extracting them you get webui.bat but no start.bat or update.bat.

After downloading, it is recommended to double-click update.bat first to update to the latest code, then double-click start.bat to launch

After launching, the browser will open automatically (if it opens blank, it is recommended to use Chrome or Edge)

macOS / Linux

Use the local setup or Docker instructions below.

features.title: Features
features.html:
Creation Workflows
  • Use AI Agent, WebUI, API, or CLI workflows for quick creation or automated production
  • Go from a topic to script, voiceover, footage, subtitles, music, and editing automatically, while retaining control over every stage
  • Generate multiple output variants in batches, review task history, and import or export generation settings and API keys
  • Track progress through script generation, voiceover, footage downloads, clip processing, and final rendering
Scripts and Model Providers
  • Use a ChatGPT subscription through OpenAI - Codex, with device-code sign-in and a dynamic model selector
  • Explicitly choose ChatGPT Native OAuth for official app authorization and account-specific models; account/workspace eligibility and a local browser/runtime are required
  • Generate or rewrite multilingual video scripts with AI, or supply a complete custom script
  • Use leading providers including Kimi / Moonshot AI, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, Alibaba Cloud Qwen, Microsoft Azure OpenAI, ByteDance VolcEngine Ark, xAI Grok, MiniMax, Muse Spark, iFlytek Spark, and Xiaomi MiMo
  • Connect through APIXO AI, APINEBULA, Jalapeno Cloud, Infistar, Fluxion AI, Cheaper Inference, Requesty, FutureInfra, Y-API, Opper, onomeo, EmpirioLabs AI, Runcrate, CloudGPU, cheapaimodel, Shengsuan Cloud, APIMart, Cloudflare AI Gateway, Alibaba ModelScope, AIHubMix, AIML API, EvoLink, OpenRouter, API Route, Kimi Code, Ollama, Claude Code subscription, OneAPI, LiteLLM, Groq, Pollinations AI, and other compatible gateways or local runtimes
Video and Image Footage
  • Upload your own local images and videos, or get HD stock footage from Pexels (free), Pixabay (free), and Coverr
  • Generate 768P or 2K source footage with Metaso MiniMax H3, with 4–15 second clips in 9:16, 16:9, or 1:1
  • Review a quote and confirm the charge to generate multiple clips with Shengsuan Cloud LoomLoom AI Video, then combine them with the project's voiceover, subtitle, and editing workflow
  • Generate AI video footage through Infistar and Jalapeno Cloud
  • Use the native Volcano Engine Ark Seedance integration to generate cohesive visuals from individual script segments
  • Turn script keywords into original video footage with WaveSpeed AI
  • Access Seedance, Wan, and other text-to-video models through OFox with a single API key
  • Generate 3–12 second AI video materials through the asynchronous MuAPI text-to-video API, with configurable endpoint, aspect ratio, resolution, and polling
  • Supports useapi.net AI video (Veo 3.1 and Gemini Omni Flash on your own Google AI plan through Google Flow or Google Vids, with free 1080p upscaling of clips up to 10 seconds on paid plans; Kling on your own Kling AI account; Seedance on your own Dreamina account), plus Nano Banana images on your own Google AI plan and Kling images on your own Kling AI account
  • Connect OpenAI-compatible text-to-image services, custom image gateways, or the included local SDXL image server; choose static or slow-zoom motion for local and generated images
  • Use OpenAI - Codex image generation with the shared ChatGPT sign-in and a separate image model selector; the account and selected model must have image-generation access
  • Adjust clip duration, playback speed, and transitions; choose crop-to-fill or letterbox fitting and random or sequential footage order
  • Optionally use TwelveLabs to rerank stock-footage search terms by video topic
Voiceover, Subtitles, and Background Music
  • Choose automatic voiceover, uploaded audio, or no voiceover, with voice samples and full narration previews
  • Use Edge TTS (free, no API key required), Azure Speech, SiliconFlow, Google Gemini, Xiaomi MiMo, MiniMax, ElevenLabs, Chatterbox, Kokoro, Fish Audio, ModelBest VoxCPM, and other voice services
  • Clone voices from reference audio with ModelBest VoxCPM, and control Edge TTS narration pauses with tags such as [pause: 2s]
  • Generate subtitles from TTS timestamps or local Whisper transcription, with sentence or word-by-word display, pop-up spring animation, and configurable font, position, color, size, outline, and background style
  • Use random music, preview preset songs, or upload local tracks; generate video-matched music with Sonilo or ElevenLabs Video-to-Music, with independent volume control
Output and Publishing
  • Export portrait 9:16 (1080×1920), landscape 16:9 (1920×1080), or square 1:1 (1080×1080) videos
  • Publish completed videos directly to TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube Shorts
  • Generate publishing titles, captions, and hashtags with an LLM, and configure YouTube visibility and whether the video is made for kids
  • Use the separate local video project CLI to revise scenes, compare versions, and reuse unchanged render artifacts
